summary: Clearway arterial kerb, no parked cars, homes and apartments within 12-20 m.

drivers.seclusion: Houses and apartments 12-21 m from the kerb along the west side; nothing screens them.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb of a multi-lane through road; no parking lane, no cars parked along it, no pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Constant through traffic on a busy arterial with a nearby signalised junction.
drivers.convention: Clearway C Mon-Fri 7am-7pm and no one parks on this kerb.

sun_shade: Open to sky; trees over the footpath at the south end.
